title: Deep operator learning for efficient sampling from invariant measures of stochastic differential equations
abstract: arXiv:2609.11376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce an amortized neural sampler that combines operator learning with flow methods for sampling. It maps SDE coefficient functions to pushforwards from a reference measure to the invariant measures, enabling efficient sampling across families of stochastic differential equations. Our framework shifts traditional sampling cost to an initial training phase, after which new SDE instances require only one encoder pass and a few ODE solver steps, independent of mixing time. To handle problems in high dimensions, we use Lagrangian trajectory sensors for the coefficient functions and cross attention in the architecture. We also theoretically establish the expressivity and resolution invariance of our framework. Experiments on 1D and 2D SDE families show competitive accuracy with substantial speedups over MCMC in regimes with slow mixing, transfer across sensor counts, and demonstration results on a 64D interacting particle SDE where t

translated_title: 用于从随机微分方程不变测度中高效采样的深度算子学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种摊销式神经采样器，将算子学习与流方法相结合用于采样。它将SDE系数函数映射为从参考测度到不变测度的前推变换，从而能够对随机微分方程族进行高效采样。我们的框架将传统的采样成本转移到初始训练阶段，此后新的SDE实例只需一次编码器传递和少量ODE求解器步骤，且与混合时间无关。为处理高维问题，我们对系数函数采用拉格朗日轨迹传感器，并在架构中使用交叉注意力机制。我们还从理论上建立了该框架的表达能力与分辨率不变性。在一维和二维SDE族上的实验表明，该方法在混合缓慢的区间内具有与MCMC相当的精度并带来显著的加速，可实现跨传感器数量的迁移，并在64维相互作用粒子SDE上展示了验证结果。
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合算子学习与流方法的摊销式神经采样器，将SDE系数函数映射为从参考测度到不变测度的前推变换，使新的SDE实例仅需一次编码器传递和少量ODE求解步骤即可采样，在混合缓慢的高维场景下相比MCMC取得显著加速。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an amortized neural sampler combining operator learning with flow methods, which maps SDE coefficient functions to pushforwards from a reference measure to invariant measures, requiring only one encoder pass and a few ODE solver steps for new SDE instances and achieving substantial speedups over MCMC in slow-mixing, high-dimensional regimes.
